'''Template:RTX''' is a version of Template:RT and can be used to let the character blink to display working machine components.<br />See [[:Template:RT|RT]] for further usage notes.

== Usage ==

<pre><nowiki>
{{RTX|<character>|<color>|<background>}}
</nowiki></pre>
